definitions.name: Off the Rails
definitions.description: P3 domain has zero ActiveRecord references and Packwerk is green.
definitions.criteria: `grep -r ActiveRecord` over the ruby P3 domain package returns 0 matches AND `verify: arch p3` exits 0

definitions.name: Signed & Sealed
definitions.description: RBS/Steep (or Sorbet) typecheck passes on the domain.
definitions.criteria: `steep check` (or `srb tc`) exits 0 over the ruby domain package

definitions.name: In Case of Pattern
definitions.description: case/in with deconstruct and >=3 arms in the domain.
definitions.criteria: grep finds a `case`/`in` expression in ruby domain code with >=3 `in` arms on a type defining deconstruct or deconstruct_keys

definitions.name: Mutant Slayer
definitions.description: mutant kill rate of at least 80% on a domain module.
definitions.criteria: `mutant run` on one ruby domain module reports kill rate >=80%
